briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate multi-agent AGI race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models amid record quarterly funding. Geopolitical tensions rise as US and China accelerate compute investments. Prompt injection threats persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced multi-agent orchestration while xAI deployed Grok-3 achieving new MATH benchmarks. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro continue scaling. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 405B variant. DeepSeek-V3 surprises with cost-efficient performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST releases new AI risk framework. Multiple exploits reported on agentic systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell clusters to major hyperscalers. Microsoft announces $20B Stargate expansion. TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators. Energy constraints slow new data center builds in Europe.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium by 2028?
